guides/cost-to-build-an-ai-app.title: How Much Does It Cost to Build an AI App? A Plain Guide
guides/cost-to-build-an-ai-app.description: What decides the cost of building an AI app, the common ways to pay for it, and how FutureAcad's Custom Build works.

blocks.html: There is no single price for an AI app. The cost depends on what it must do, how much data it needs, how many people will use it, and who builds and hosts it. This guide explains each factor, the common ways to pay, and how FutureAcad, a Dubai-based deep tech startup, charges for a Custom Build.

items: 6 to 8 weeks to a first version

h1.main: How much does it cost to build an AI app?

blocks.html: Two apps that look alike on screen can cost very different amounts to build and to run. What matters is what the app has to do, the data behind it, the systems it connects to, and how heavily it is used.
The sections below show what moves the cost up or down, so you can compare quotes fairly.

atoms.html: A simple assistant that answers questions from your documents is smaller than an app that makes calls, reads files, updates your CRM and reports on results.
Clean, organised data makes the work faster. Scattered or missing data has to be sorted first, and that takes time.
Linking the app to your CRM, ERP, email or WhatsApp adds work for each connection.

atoms.text: Who uses it, and how much

atoms.html: More users, more calls and more data mean a larger running cost, such as hosting and AI usage.
Apps that handle customer or financial data need more careful design and checks.
Many people budget only for the build. Hosting, AI usage and updates continue every month.

sections.title: Questions to ask any AI developer.

items.q: Is it really free to build?
a: For a standard solution FutureAcad can also offer to others, yes. You pay for hosting and usage once it is live.
FutureAcad owns a standard build, and you have the right to use it. You can buy the source code and the rights at any time.

items.q: How long does the first version take?
a: A working first version takes 6 to 8 weeks.

items.q: What if my app is unique to my business?
a: A product that cannot be offered to others carries a basic development fee. We quote it on the scoping call.
